# thalassa_endpoints (Data Source)

List endpoints. Optionally filter by VPC identity or resource identity.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `organisation_id` (String) Reference to the Organisation of the endpoints. If not provided, the organisation of the (Terraform) provider will be used.
- `resource_identity` (String) Filter endpoints by the identity of the attached resource
- `vpc_id` (String) Filter endpoints by VPC identity

### Read-Only

- `endpoints` (List of Object) List of endpoints that match the filter criteria (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--endpoints))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--endpoints"></a>

Read-Only:

- `endpoint_hostname` (String)
